vault.title: CSCI3240 Introduction to Computer Vision Syllabus
vault.summary: This document outlines the 15-week schedule, grading policy, and lab requirements for the Introduction to Computer Vision course taught by Abenova Saule. Students will learn core computer vision concepts ranging from image processing basics and filtering to advanced topics like deep learning and object detection. The course grading is based on labs, a midterm exam, and a final project.
key_terms: Convolution: A mathematical operation used in image filtering.
Sobel and Canny: Popular algorithms for edge detection.
SIFT and ORB: Algorithms used for feature description and matching.
Homography: A transformation relating the points of two images of the same planar surface.
RANSAC: An iterative method to estimate mathematical model parameters from noisy data.
CNN: Convolutional Neural Networks used for image classification.
